edges.reason: msg.sender indexes the permissions mapping for every authorization check
execute requires address(this) == stabilityBoardProxyAddress, i.e. proxy delegatecall only
transfer uses msg.sender as the source account
delegatedTransfer pays the executor fee to msg.sender
transferFrom spends the allowance granted to msg.sender
transferNotification treats msg.sender as the legacy token address
placeBuyTokenOrder stores msg.sender as the order maker
PreToken.transferAgreement restricted to PreTokenSigner (can seize agreement ownership)
PreToken.transfer resolves the agreement of msg.sender
collect is intentionally callable by anyone
releaseFunds is callable by anyone and does not check the lock owner
setRate stores now as lastUpdated, price freshness depends on block.timestamp
setMultipleRates stores now for each symbol
collect requires now >= loan.maturity to seize collateral
uint40 maturity cast of now+term can truncate for long terms
uint40 lockedUntil cast of now+durationInSecs can truncate
matchMultipleOrders loop bound depends on gasleft()
orders.length-- underflows when the array is empty
execute delegatecalls the caller supplied scriptAddress stored in the scripts mapping
delegatecall executes in MultiSig storage so script state can be overwritten or re-entered
lock.isActive is set false before the external token transfer
state change precedes the external augmintToken interaction
augmintToken.transferWithNarrative is an external call made during lock release
token payout to buy.maker happens before the ETH payout to sell.maker
ETH transfer to sell.maker occurs after the external token call
ETH transfers to defaulted borrowers and fee accounts happen inside the collection loop
ETH refund to the order maker happens after order.amount is zeroed (CEI respected)
token refund to msg.sender via transferWithNarrative during cancellation
delegatedTransferAndNotify calls target.transferNotification on arbitrary target
transferAndNotify performs the internal token transfer before the callback
delegatedTransfer validates the offline signature and nonce via the helper
ecrecover returns address(0) on a malformed signature
txHash is recorded in delegatedTxHashesUsed to prevent replay
setup script grants StabilityBoard permissions through the proxy
setup script revokes the deployer PermissionGranter
setup script grants multiple pretoken permissions to the PreTokenProxy

calculateTransferFee reads the NoTransferFee permission of from and to
addAgreement maps the owner to the agreement hash
transfer routes into the internal fee-aware _transfer
transferFrom routes into the internal fee-aware _transfer
_transfer updates balances of from, to and feeAccount
issueLoan calls augmintToken.issueTo under MonetarySupervisor permission
requestInterest enforces the ltdParams max lock limit
issueLoan enforces the ltdParams max loan limit
legacy token burn plus issueTo new tokens executed on the notification callback
newEthBackedLoan reads the LoanProduct from products
newEthBackedLoan pushes LoanData into the loans array
newEthBackedLoan uses rates.convertFromWei for the collateral value

placeBuyTokenOrder accepts msg.value ETH into the contract

withdraw sends ETH to an arbitrary to address

normalization_plan.reason: script selector address is only used to look up and delegatecall the target script
agent address is the permission grantee written into permissions
bytes32 permission key is the second index of the permissions mapping
owner address becomes the key of agreementOwners and the Agreement.owner
amount is the balance/totalSupply delta validated by SafeMath in burn
recipient address is the destination of the balance update in transfer
source address is debited by the internal fee-aware transfer
loanId indexes the loans array in the internal repayment routine
buy order id selects the storage Order mutated during settlement
sell order id selects the storage Order mutated during settlement
lockId indexes locks in the release routine
rate array is written into the rates mapping by the oracle setter
signature bytes are consumed by the signature recovery check
productId selects the LoanProduct used to originate the loan
Script storage pointer only carries the script state machine used by execute
recovered address is the output of the ecrecover based recovery
fee local only holds the value returned by the fee calculation
interest local only carries the value passed to requestInterest
tradedWei local only carries the ETH amount moved during settlement
releasedCollateral local only carries the ETH refunded during collection
Lock storage pointer is the mutable state used during release
Order storage pointer is the mutable state zeroed during cancellation
